title: Remove product listing grid section shown in uploaded screenshot

requirements.text: Remove the product listing grid section currently visible on the homepage that displays product cards in a multi-row grid format (showing items such as 'Digital Printed Notebook', 'Digital Wall Art', 'Poster Collage with Photo', 'Custom Canvas Prints', 'Framed Photo Collage', 'Custom Poster Printing', 'Custom Water Bottles', 'Branded Notebooks', 'Wooden Photo Frame', 'Metallic Frame', 'Collage Frame', 'Square Photo Magnets', 'Family Magnet Set', 'Classic White Photo Mug', 'Color Changing Mug', 'Classic 4×6 Prints', 'Premium Matte Prints', 'Square Prints' with category labels, prices, and delivery times). This section must be completely removed from `frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx` and any component it delegates to. All other homepage sections (hero banner, category grid, featured products, shop frames by size, offers banner, trust features, customer reviews, FAQ, footer) must remain intact and unaffected.
acceptanceCriteria: The multi-row product listing grid shown in the uploaded screenshot (image-13.png) no longer appears anywhere on the homepage.
No product cards with category labels, prices in the format shown (e.g., '₹249', '₹499'), and delivery time text (e.g., '5-7 business days') from that grid section are rendered on the homepage.

All other homepage sections remain visible and fully functional: hero banner, product category grid, featured products, shop frames by size, offers banner, trust features, customer reviews, FAQ section, and footer.
No JavaScript errors or broken layout appear after the removal.

constraints: Do not remove or modify any other homepage section besides the specific product listing grid shown in the uploaded screenshot.
Do not alter any backend logic or data.
nonGoals: Modifying backend product data or seeding logic.
Changing the admin panel in any way.
